_comment: Time-bound npm-audit exceptions for the PRODUCTION frontend tree (TC-1 / OD-TC-1-D gate; enforced by scripts/check_frontend_audit.mjs). Every exception MUST be reachability-justified (why the advisory cannot execute in this app) and carry a review_by date; an EXPIRED exception FAILS CI to force re-review, and any advisory NOT listed here still fails the gate. This is a disposition, not a suppression.
_history: EMPTY since FE-M1 (2026-07-28), and empty is the intended steady state. The one exception this file ever held — GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2, the react-router RSC-mode CSRF advisory, dispositioned 2026-07-24 with review_by 2026-10-24 — was RETIRED BY FIX, not by expiry: FE-M1 migrated the app to react-router@8.3.0 (the patched version) on React 19, so the advisory is no longer present in the tree at all. The mechanism stays because npm audit queries a LIVE advisory DB: an unchanged tree can flip green->red at any time, and the next advisory will need this same disposition path. An empty `exceptions` array means NOTHING IS EXCUSED — it does not mean nothing is checked; that distinction is pinned by apps/frontend/audit-gate.test.ts.
